# CyanCast

> CyanCast is the brand and trading company (Singapore-oriented); Xi Yan Broadcasting (Guangzhou, China) handles R&D and manufacturing of the Desktop Commercial Wireless Audio Hub. One host wirelessly broadcasts to an unlimited number of terminals up to 120 m for commercial sound, background music and multi-zone paging. Core differentiators: built-in gooseneck microphone, MIC priority (auto-mute), A/B dual-zone independent control, and a secure undiscoverable terminal network. Target markets: houses of worship (church, mosque), schools, hotels, retail, factories/warehouses, restaurants and corporate.

## Company
- CyanCast — brand owner and trading company (Singapore-oriented). Owns the brand; leads international sales, distribution and partner relationships.
- Xi Yan Broadcasting — based in Guangzhou, China. Responsible for research, development and manufacturing (the wireless protocol, hardware and build quality).
- The two are separate companies: the brand is CyanCast's, the engineering and manufacturing are Xi Yan Broadcasting's.

## Products
- [Desktop Commercial Wireless Audio Hub](https://cyancast.com/products/desktop-wireless-audio-hub): Wireless audio host with gooseneck mic, A/B zones, Bluetooth broadcast, unlimited terminals, 120 m coverage. Three terminal forms: ceiling, wall-mount, waterproof column.

## Systems
- [Commercial Sound System](https://cyancast.com/commercial-sound-system): Scalable wireless commercial audio for shops, campuses and factories.
- [Background Music System](https://cyancast.com/background-music-system): BGM from USB/Bluetooth/AUX with MIC priority auto-mute.
- [Multi-Zone Audio System](https://cyancast.com/multi-zone-audio-system): Independent A/B zone control from one host.

## Applications
- [Applications Overview](https://cyancast.com/applications): All venues.
- [Wireless PA for Church](https://cyancast.com/wireless-pa-system-for-church): Clear sermons and hymns, no cabling.
- [Sound System for School](https://cyancast.com/sound-system-for-school): Campus paging and BGM.
- [Hotel Background Music](https://cyancast.com/hotel-background-music-system): Per-zone ambience and guest paging.
- [Commercial Audio for Retail](https://cyancast.com/commercial-audio-for-retail): Shop music and staff paging.
- [Wireless PA for Factory & Warehouse](https://cyancast.com/wireless-pa-for-factory-warehouse): Rugged over-noise paging.
- [Audio System for Mosque](https://cyancast.com/audio-system-for-mosque): Clear khutbah and calls to prayer.
- [Restaurant Background Music](https://cyancast.com/restaurant-background-music): Dining ambience + counter paging.
- [Bluetooth PA for Restaurant](https://cyancast.com/bluetooth-pa-restaurant): Wireless PA + BGM.
- [Corporate Presentation Audio](https://cyancast.com/corporate-presentation-audio): Meetings, training and paging.
